brief.title: Create once. Review. Deliver.
brief.narration: A useful video workflow starts with a clear message. Build your story, review every scene and listen to the complete narration. Approve the finished draft before delivery. Your video stays in the cloud, ready to download, with no rendering software installed on your n8n machine.
brief.caption: Cloud video production, with human review before delivery. #OrbitPage #Automation
